ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the financial document:  Adani Power Limited reported exceptionally strong consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, demonstrating significant year-over-year and quarter-over-quarter growth in both revenue and net profit. A key material impact for the quarter was a substantial tax reversal of over ₹1,200 Crores relating to earlier years, which significantly boosted current period earnings and should be considered when evaluating recurring profitability. While the independent auditor issued an unmodified limited review report, it noted reliance on other auditors for several subsidiaries and management-certified data for some immaterial entities.
